title: limpet profile file
description: Authoritative per-profile file (~/.config/limpet/profiles/{shortId}.profile.json). Hand-editing this file and saving live-applies through limpet's reconcile path. Dropping a NEW file with an unknown, well-formed `id` CREATES that profile (persisted unless refused; the launchd agent installs only when the new profile is `isEnabled` and has all required fields filled in) — creation-via-file is supported, not just editing an existing profile. Refused: an rcloneRemote starting with ':' or containing ',' or '=' (the file does not load), transfers outside 1-64, and a remote path equal to or nested with an enabled, installed profile on the same remote (the file is moved to profiles/refused/). Keep this file's `properties` in lockstep with SyncProfile.CodingKeys (limpet/Models/SyncProfile.swift) — verified by scripts/check-schema-in-sync.sh.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file. Written automatically; safe to ignore.

id.description: Stable profile identifier. Do not change — a changed id is treated as a different profile.

name.description: Display name shown in the limpet UI.

localSyncPath.description: Local folder path synced with the remote.

drivePathToMonitor.description: External drive mount point to monitor (empty if not on an external drive).

additionalRcloneFlags.description: Extra flags appended to the rclone command. Whitespace-separated (split on IFS, not shell-parsed) and passed to rclone as literal argv elements, so write them as --flag=value (e.g. --exclude=*.tmp --bwlimit=5M): no shell quoting or expansion, a flag's value cannot contain a space, and a quote, $, backtick, or a token starting with ~ is refused (sync exits 64) rather than passed through.

isEnabled.description: Whether the scheduled sync agent is installed. Toggling this installs or uninstalls the launchd agent.

isMuted.description: Whether file-change notifications are muted for this profile.

transfers.description: rclone --transfers for this profile's sync (--checkers is 2x this value). Default 16.

maxDelete.description: rclone --max-delete for this profile when its remote keeps no deleted versions: MEGA S4 and Cloudflare R2 always, AWS/MinIO/other S3 unless remoteVersioning is true. When a run hits the limit, rclone stops after this many deletions, the sync exits 76 and limpet stops syncing the profile until `limpet profile clear-delete-limit` (or the menu action) clears it. Default 100.

remoteVersioning.description: Set to true only if the S3 bucket keeps deleted versions (versioning on); lifts maxDelete for AWS/MinIO/other S3 remotes. Ignored for MEGA S4 and Cloudflare R2. Default false.
